hec.io

Class HecFileImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.io.File
      • hec.io.HecFileImpl
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    HecFile, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<java.io.File>

    public class HecFileImpl
extends java.io.File
implements HecFile, java.io.Serializable
    HecFileImpl is a file for use in both a RMI Networked and Local environment. HecFileImpl's intent is to be the client side file object.

    Construct a HecFileImpl using a FilePath Object or with a RmiFileImpl RemoteWrapper.

    Use getBufferedReader for UNICODE Reading of a HecFile.
    Use getBufferedWriter for UNICODE Writing of a HecFile.
    NOTE - the writing must be followed by a save() to send the byte[] to the RmiFileImpl.

    Author:
    Peter S. Morris
    See Also:
    RmiFileImpl, FilePath, Serialized Form
